text:
maya_cs: Heads-up: Cedar Isle wants to cutover to Private VPC next Wednesday. Top concerns from their compliance: KMS key scoping, audit log retention (7y required), SIEM forwarding to their Splunk instance, and an explicit redaction policy for model inputs. They also warned renewal could be impacted if retention/chain-of-custody isn't documented.

arun_net: Networking notes: TGW attachments done. Recommend VPC gateway endpoint for S3 (vpce-0c1d2e3f) to avoid NAT. Need an SG rule to collector.redwood.internal:443 and to their Splunk HEC endpoint (splunk.cedar.internal:8088).

bernard_sre: For logs: we can support S3 replication + push to Splunk HEC. Staging numbers: S3 put -> replication -> Splunk indexed median ~35s using endpoint. If they insist on direct push from their VPC to Splunk, add 6-8s.

lina_security: KMS: created customer key alias: alias/redwood/cedar-logs (arn:aws:kms:us-east-2:444455556666:key/ced-abc). Recommended cross-account principal: arn:aws:iam::777788889999:role/redwood-logging-prod. Policy we propose limits to Encrypt & GenerateDataKey and binds kms:EncryptionContext: {"team":"redwood-logging","cust":"cedar"} to prevent key reuse. Also propose log object lifecycle rules that enforce 7y retention and WORM via S3 Object Lock where supported.

rachel_cedaradmin: On WORM: our org requires immutable retention for some buckets. Can you provide exact Object Lock configuration and how we prove chain-of-custody for audits? Also, who signs off on retaining hashed inputs vs raw prompts?

maya_cs: Lina, please produce a short "chain-of-custody" doc + Object Lock snippet. Rachel, for raw prompts we default to hashed-only output; raw prompt forwarding requires a signed addendum.

lina_security: Dropping the KMS snippet here (minimal):

```
Action: kms:Encrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey
Principal: arn:aws:iam::777788889999:role/redwood-logging-prod
Condition: StringEquals kms:EncryptionContext.team = "redwood-logging"
```

Also: we'll provide Object Lock example and a short audit checklist by EOD.

infra-bot: Dry-run scheduled: 2026-05-12T03:00:00Z. Staging results: S3 endpoint + replication -> Splunk HEC = 34s median, Object Lock enabled buckets verified in staging.

bernard_sre: Canary from Cedar VPC -> our collector: HTTP/1.1 200 OK; object available in Redwood S3 and staged to Splunk in 37s. Marking canary PASS.

maya_cs: Action items: 1) @lina_security publish chain-of-custody + Object Lock config (EOD), 2) @arun_net ensure SG rule to Splunk HEC and share rule id, 3) @rachel_cedaradmin confirm KMS policy applied and whether you will accept hashed-only logs or request addendum. I'll label renewal "high-risk" until KMS + WORM confirmation.

rachel_cedaradmin: We applied the KMS policy with the EncryptionContext condition. We'll review Object Lock doc and decide on hashed vs raw; likely hashed-only.

maya_cs: Thanks. Moving thread to monitor; will close after Object Lock doc + final acceptance.
